description: Convert JPG, PNG and other images to the modern WebP format for much smaller file sizes at the same visual quality. Batch convert and download as a ZIP.

faqs.a: WebP is typically 25–35% smaller than JPG at the same visual quality, and unlike JPG it supports transparency. All modern browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari 14+) display WebP.
faqs.q: Why use WebP instead of JPG?

faqs.a: Yes — WebP supports alpha transparency just like PNG, so transparent areas stay transparent.
No. Conversion happens entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded and there are no limits.

howto: Drop one or more images (JPG, PNG, …) into the upload zone.
Click “Convert to WebP” and compare original vs WebP sizes.
Download each .webp file individually or all together as a ZIP.
title: WebP Converter
